name: lru-cache
solves: Provides a high-performance in-process least-recently-used cache for Node.js with TTL, size-based eviction, fetch Method patterns, and zero network dependencies — ideal for hot-path memoization.
best_for: In-process memoization and hot-path caches where Redis would be overkill
Libraries and CLIs that need a tiny, dependency-light LRU with TTL
Per-instance caches that must not share state across servers
Bounding memory with max item count or max size limits
Synchronous cache lookups without async network I/O
skip_when: You need a shared cache across multiple processes or hosts — use Redis
You need disk-backed or multi-driver storage (unstorage/Keyv)
Cache stampede protection and distributed invalidation are requirements
You are on edge isolates with strict memory limits and different primitives
You only need a single Map with manual deletes and no eviction policy
